subject: Engagement launch brief: Skyline AI POC (scope & next steps)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@skyline-ai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement launch brief: Skyline AI POC (scope & next steps)

Hi Sam —

Great to connect today. As promised, below is a concise launch brief summarizing the pain, goals we heard, proposed pilot scope, success metrics, owners, and immediate access steps so your team can start the work next week. I attached a one-page charter and the initial prompt set for your review.

1) Pain points you described
- Search and QA: retrieval is slow and often returns low-relevance results for leasing and asset data queries.
- Hallucination risk when agents synthesize financial estimates from incomplete records.
- Running inference costs spiking during end-of-quarter runs.

2) High-level goals for the POC (4 weeks)
- Achieve a 20% increase in top-3 relevance (NDCG@3) vs current baseline.
- Median response latency <= 200ms for single-turn queries (P50).
- Demonstrate stable cost per 1k tokens at or below the target you provided.
- Reduce hallucination rate on financial Q&A by 30% (evaluated on the provided prompt set).

3) Proposed scope
- Duration: 4 weeks (week-by-week milestones below).
- Dataset: up to 50k anonymized query/response pairs from your historical logs + a 500-item eval holdout.
- Model variants: open Llama-2 family we run on Redwood Dedicated; we'll compare baseline -> quantized variant + cache-enabled runtime.
- Prompt set & evals: we will run the attached 120-prompt set (you can add examples), compute NDCG/recall and hallucination metrics.

4) Success metrics & acceptance criteria
- NDCG@3 improvement >= 20% over baseline on holdout.
- Latency P50 <= 200ms, P95 <= 800ms for targeted routes.
- Hallucination reduction >= 30% on labeled cases.
- No PII leakage in output samples (we'll include a small privacy checklist).

5) Owners & roles
- Redwood: Rachel Kim (sales lead, timelines & contracting), Ben Carter (SE – integration, evals), Priyom Das (onboarding & infra).
- Skyline AI: Sam Torres (product owner), Priyanka Rao (engineering lead), Marcus Chen (data lead).

6) Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (Nov 8): Kickoff + access & data handoff.
- Week 1: Baseline ingest, initial infra setup, run baseline eval.
- Week 2: Model tuning, prompt iteration, mid-POC check-in.
- Week 3: Final evals & cost profiling.
- Week 4: Wrap, results review, and next-step recommendation.

7) Immediate access/setup items (actionable)
- Skyline to create a cross-account IAM role for Redwood deployment (guidance attached) or provide S3 read access for the sample dataset.
- Provide a small sample export (500 rows) to the shared Drive folder by Nov 6.
- Approve a sandbox API key / allowlist Redwood dev IPs for testing.
- Confirm whether you prefer Redwood Dedicated capacity for the POC or to run on hosted with burst capacity; we'll price both.

Ask: Can you confirm (a) that the above scope matches your expectations, (b) whether we should plan for Dedicated capacity for the POC, and (c) that the sample dataset will be uploaded by EOD Nov 6? Once you confirm I will schedule the kickoff and share detailed onboarding steps.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0129

Attachments: skyline-poc-charter-v1.xlsx, skyline-sample-prompt-set.csv
From: Sam Torres <s.torres@skyline-ai.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyanka Rao <pri@skyline-ai.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement launch brief: Skyline AI POC (scope & next steps)

Thanks Rachel — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. Quick notes:
- We can get the 500-row sample to the Drive by COB Nov 6.
- Priyanka will confirm whether Dedicated is required; initial preference is Dedicated if the latency targets are achievable within our cost band. Please include a rough Dedicated estimate in the kickoff materials.
- We need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an IP/data handling statement before we put production data into any sandbox. Can your security team share the SOC2 report and a short data handling one-pager?

Happy to proceed — tentative kickoff preference: Monday, Nov 8 at 10:00am PT. I will confirm after syncing with Priyanka.

Sam
Product Lead, Skyline AI
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Skyline POC — immediate asks and owner list

Team —

Quick internal note after Sam's reply. Items to action before we confirm the kickoff:
1) Security pack: Can Priyom share SOC2 Type II and the standard data handling one-pager (redwood-security-pack.pdf) to Sam by EOD Nov 5? He specifically called for SOC2 before sandboxing.
2) Dedicated estimate: Ben — can you produce a 4-week Dedicated cost/throughput estimate (guesstimate + recommended GPU type) by EOD Nov 4 so I can include it in the kickoff deck? Sam prefers Dedicated if it meets latency/cost.
3) Onboarding checklist: Priyom — prepare the IAM role instructions and a short S3 path example. I'll own scheduling and the meeting invite.

I'll draft the kickoff invite once we have the security doc and Ben's estimate. I put the draft charter and prompt set in the Drive link.

Thanks —
Rachel
